meta.title: DSHChatMode Proactive Chat
meta.description:
Lets the model start conversations on its own within the hours you allow: it checks in, gossips, asks about your body and the weather, or just pings you to say it misses you — then keeps chatting when you reply.

How to use: open Settings → Proactive chat to toggle it, pick an interval (10/20/30/60 minutes or custom), drag active and do-not-disturb windows, edit the topic pool, and choose a dedicated chat or an existing session; press Save to apply instantly, or Say something now to trigger one message. In any session you can also tell the model "turn on proactive chat", "ping me every 30 minutes", "don't disturb me after 11pm", "bind it to this session", or "use a dedicated session" — it calls the chatmode tool against the same settings. Settings live in <DSH_HOME>/chatmode/state.json on this machine and can be edited by hand; changes apply automatically.

Each ping only delivers a reminder into the target session; the reply is generated by that session's own persona (whatever preset or persona files you configured) — no persona text is sent by this plugin. The task appears on the Automation tasks page as "DSHChatMode 主动聊天" with a placeholder next-run date (the real cadence is computed by the plugin); please do not edit it there.

Limits: pings happen only while the DSH client is running; one reply is 1-3 short lines (segments in one message, not separate bubbles); the minimum interval is 5 minutes; there is a per-day cap; if the target session is mid-turn the ping is skipped and retried in 10 minutes; changing settings never rewrites history.

Added model requests: each ping wakes the target session for one reply turn. Turning the plugin off stops pings; the placeholder task is recreated on the next enable or can be deleted from the Automation page.
